clarity_and_focus.intentional_blur: Motion blur, shallow depth of field, soft focus, and dreamlike softening effects.
clarity_and_focus.multiple_exposure_overlay: Double exposures, ghosted subjects, and layered overlapping frames.
clarity_and_focus.film_and_digital_artifacts: Grain, noise, VHS decay, scanlines, datamoshing, compression errors, and lo-fi texture.

color_and_tone.clashing_and_disharmony: Aggressively conflicting palettes, toxic neon, wrong object colors, and chromatic aberration.
color_and_tone.muted_and_faded: Desaturated, washed-out, monotone, or retro faded tones with low vibrancy.
color_and_tone.sickly_and_inconsistent: Unhealthy color casts, uneven white balance, color banding, and mixed color temperatures.

lighting_and_exposure.exposure_extremes: Deliberate underexposure, overexposure, crushed shadows, or blown highlights.
lighting_and_exposure.flash_and_light_leak: Harsh or insufficient flash, specular hotspots, and simulated light leak streaks.
lighting_and_exposure.flat_and_low_contrast: Absence of directional light, collapsed depth, crushed midtones, and oppressive tonal compression.

composition_and_structure.unconventional_framing: Tilted horizons, skewed angles, off-level framing, and deliberate instability.
composition_and_structure.obstructed_and_cropped: Subjects cut off, blocked, or hidden at frame edges with withheld information.
composition_and_structure.snapshot_and_scale: Amateur snapshot energy, awkward timing, and unrealistic or surreal scale relationships.

emotion_and_subject.negative_emotion: Expressions of sadness, anger, fear, distress, or scenes evoking depression and dread.
emotion_and_subject.decay_and_disgust: Aged, broken, dirty, rotten, or physically deteriorated subjects and environments.
emotion_and_subject.unfinished_and_raw: Deliberately exposed construction, visible incompleteness, and rough unpolished process.
